title: The 3 Best Ergonomic Mice 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for ergonomic mice 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at ergonomic mice 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Logitech MX Master 3S
products.blurb: Key specs: Full-size ergonomic shape, MagSpeed scroll wheel, Bluetooth multi-device (3 devices).
strengths: Large body reduces thumb abduction strain for large-handed users
MagSpeed scroll wheel is the best scroll wheel in any mouse, precise and fast
Thumb rest contour reduces thumb muscle fatigue
limitations: Not vertical, standard flat orientation. Wrist pronation is not addressed
Large size uncomfortable for small-medium hands (under 19cm hand length)
